market_view: Refreshed screen (as_of 2026-11-23) now reads normal, not defensive: breadth 52% above SMA200, VWCE.DE +2.4% and SXR8.DE +4.2% above SMA200; only EQQQ.DE is near trend (+0.2%), a tech signal. Macro backdrop is still hawkish (Fed hiking cycle, Goldman calling for two more hikes) and Tuesday's tape is testing the Nvidia-led rebound as chips fall, so I favour low-volatility, non-tech leaders over oversold tech. Two modest buys that diversify the MUV2.DE (EU insurance) holding: an EU utility and a US staple, both near highs with recent positive company catalysts and no earnings until 2027.
